newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 31,400 head confirmed for the week which includes 26,800 formulated cattle and 3,200 head or 79 loads CME cattle delivered. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00.
Confirmed - 1,200 Last Week - 200 Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 31,400 Last Week - 36,200 Year Ago - 24,500
